en.title: Count Palindromic Substrings
en.description:
Given a lowercase string s, count all position pairs (i,j) with i≤j such that s[i..j] is a palindrome. Identical content at different positions is counted separately. The second upstream example gives the output for wowyouwin as 14, which conflicts with this definition; counting position by position as the statement defines gives 10, and this site uses 10.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: One line containing a non-empty string of only a-z. Added by this site: 1≤|s|≤200000.
en.output: Output the number of palindromic substring occurrences, as a 64-bit integer.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
